profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Tesla
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer with a passion for usable and intuitive systems. My main focus is on organization and clean code, but also enjoy exploring new ways of thinking through problems and have a good sense for picking apart code and understanding the logic behind it. I have experience in the different stages of project development and feel comfortable working with UI as well as building and architecting robust and resilient micro-services.

I am currently working in different projects developed in C#, Angular, MySql, Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ. 

When I'm not working on web development, I enjoy exercising, playing baseball and reading books, especially thrillers.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: .NET · ASP.NET Web API · C# · LINQ · RabbitMQ · Apache Kafka · MySQL · SQL · AngularJS · Git · CSS · Visual Studio · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: Part of a team redesigning a 12-year-old equity management system originally developed in VB.NET, Web Pages and Oracle and now redesign with a newer stack. Development in .NET MVC and WebAPI, C#, Javascript, Angular.JS 1.XX, and Oracle as a database.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Development of a system to automate the review of survey responses and creation of a rating system to detects fraud and/or invalid responses, thus reducing the total review time substantially.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Consultant at Tesla Motors:
Development of two custom .NET applications that simplify the Globalization process for the IT department in over 50%.
Completely developed an Angular.JS + MVC + Web API project for the IT department that allows HR to capitalize employee and contractor hours.
PrimeSport project:
Part of the team that implemented a major transition into paperless tickets with FlashSeats.
Added a complex functionality for managing MVC redirects dynamically as well as preventing site reloads when redirecting.
Development in .NET 4.0 using C#, MVC and NHibernate.

positions.title: Enterprise Web Developer
positions.description:
Developing JSP, Spring, Struts. Worked on Oracle Database. Developed a web application that connects with the Harvest API and calculated new data. Done through jQuery, JS, PHP, HTML, CSS3.
Consulting services for large enterprise. Maintenance and development of sites through IBM's WCM and Websphere Portal.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed web application on .NET framework. Worked on Visual Studio 2008 & Visual Studio 2010. Developed on C#, ASPX, CSS, JS. Used SQL Management Studio 2005 and used Linq and Lambda.

projects.title: EM - Diablo
projects.description:
Redesign of a legacy application built in VB.Net into MVC5, WebApi, EF, and AngularJS system. 
This system is an equity management SaaS that streamlines the equity process and simplifies the administration of equity plans.

projects.title: PrimeSport
projects.description: Development of web portal. ASP.NET MVC, NHibernate, jQuery, CSS.
